item.btt.balloon.tooltip: Right-click someone nearby to raise their voice pitch after a delay; a second use makes them explode. The ability key temporarily makes them deaf and mute.
item.btt.bomb.tooltip:
Use to plant a bomb on the person ahead; the countdown begins later
If you carry a bomb, use on someone else to pass it on
item.btt.bow.tooltip:
Hold use to draw; no cooldown on a miss; player hits trigger cooldown
Passengers die after a wrongful execution; Rangers reverse this rule
item.btt.cage_choice.tooltip: Right-click to choose Live or Die. After %s seconds, everyone dies if no living eligible prisoner chose Die.
item.btt.crossbow.desc1: Multishot I, Piercing IV (no enchant glint)
item.btt.crossbow.desc2: No cooldown on a miss; this crossbow breaks after hitting a player
item.btt.dagger.tooltip: Use on someone nearby for a silent assassination

item.btt.fire_axe.tooltip:
The Psychopath's weapon: fully charge for a fatal strike
After a kill, attacks are temporarily disabled
item.btt.pipe.tooltip:
Equip to attack briefly without charging
Afterward, attacks are disabled until it cools down
item.btt.poison_gas_grenade.tooltip: Throw to fill the room with poison gas; lingering inside poisons you
item.btt.poison_needle.tooltip: Use to poison someone nearby, a plate or a glass
item.btt.remote.tooltip: Use to link the nearest trap nearby; use again to activate
item.btt.sword.tooltip: Use to throw a sword that pierces everyone in its path

announcement.goal.btt.vigilante: Eliminate every murderer and protect the innocent.
announcement.goal.btt.caballero: With that, he fitted his breastplate, gripped his lance, and spurred his horse toward the first windmill.
announcement.goal.btt.ranger: Let justice prevail, though the world perish.
announcement.goal.btt.witch: Round about the cauldron go: In the poisoned entrails throw.
announcement.goal.btt.veteran: Ten years spent honing a sword; its frosted edge has yet to be tested.
announcement.goal.btt.gunslinger: A gunshot rings out, and the matter is settled.
announcement.goal.btt.night_watchman: The air is dry: beware of fire.
announcement.goal.btt.elder: One final rally can turn the tide.
announcement.goal.btt.saint: God will wipe away all their tears, and death will be no more.
announcement.goal.btt.cannibal: If only, one sunlit morning, the Indians could strip all those Portuguese bare.
announcement.goal.btt.philosopher: Philosophers have only interpreted the world in different ways; the point is to change it.
announcement.goal.btt.undercover: Be careful not to let them discover you.
announcement.goal.btt.architect: Escape through a passage of your own making.
announcement.goal.btt.locksmith: The mere existence of a lock lets me deduce this much. What do you think, everyone?
announcement.goal.btt.puppeteer: And at once, I cast aside my humanity.
announcement.goal.btt.craftsman: Replicate the item in hand and pass it to the next traveler.
announcement.goal.btt.detective: Detection is an exact science, to be studied with the same coolness, rather than emotion.
announcement.goal.btt.prophet: Blurred faces emerge within the crystal ball.
announcement.goal.btt.doctor: The body is your most reliable witness.
announcement.goal.btt.investigator: Discern the truth between two possible roles.
announcement.goal.btt.folklorist: Religion rests on belief in a supernatural power capable of changing nature's course at will.
announcement.goal.btt.muyuubyou: This is a game of wandering through a dream world steeped in darkness.
announcement.goal.btt.noble: The Rokkenjima mass murders: the killing of the Ushiromiya family on Rokkenjima.
announcement.goal.btt.balloonist: To see a thousand miles farther, climb one story higher.
announcement.goal.btt.mortician: The sorrow in my heart remains, and now the one in my arms is gone.
announcement.goal.btt.tailor: See who stands on the same side.
announcement.goal.btt.medium: What lies in eternal sleep is not dead; across strange aeons, even death may pass away.
announcement.goal.btt.virgin: Originally there is nothing; where could dust alight?
announcement.goal.btt.star: Death is your grandest curtain call.
announcement.goal.btt.professor: Now, all we need is a bolt of lightning.
announcement.goal.btt.bodyguard: Through fire and water, without hesitation.
announcement.goal.btt.snake_charmer: Human greed is a snake trying to swallow an elephant.
announcement.goal.btt.monk: Form is no different from emptiness; emptiness is no different from form. Form is emptiness, and emptiness is form.
announcement.goal.btt.conductor: The train reaches its destination, and the truth comes to light.
announcement.goal.btt.attendant: The train speeds toward the terminal station.
announcement.goal.btt.bartender: Bells, drums and lavish feasts are nothing to treasure; let me stay drunk and never wake.
announcement.goal.btt.poppy_grower: Breathe its heady scent and be lost forever, a slave to the gods of light and darkness.
announcement.goal.btt.assassin: Let your prey die by their own secrets.
announcement.goal.btt.agent: No true role can escape your scrutiny.
announcement.goal.btt.actor: Your changing face will be your alibi.
announcement.goal.btt.stowaway: Arrive without a shadow; leave without a trace.
announcement.goal.btt.imp: But if you must trust someone, trust me.
announcement.goal.btt.leech: As long as they live, you will not die.
announcement.goal.btt.riot: Long live the revolution! My revolution!
announcement.goal.btt.vortex: Black and white are reversed; right and wrong are no more.
announcement.goal.btt.sculptor: Would a sculptor not want to smash the marble to pieces when it refuses to take the shape they imagined?
announcement.goal.btt.magician: The great human-swapping magic show begins now!
announcement.goal.btt.rigger: I was hired to give form to people's fantasies—their deepest, darkest fantasies.
announcement.goal.btt.leviathan: Heart of hell, I meet you with my blade. Hatred burns away, yet my fury will not rest.
announcement.goal.btt.swordsman: Pierce their ridiculous unity with your sword.
announcement.goal.btt.alchemist: As above, so below; thus is the miracle of the One accomplished.
announcement.goal.btt.terrorist: Guess who gets the bomb next?
announcement.goal.btt.cleaner: There are fewer people in the room. They have not noticed.
announcement.goal.btt.colonel: A gun that serves no justice; bullets that serve no law.
announcement.goal.btt.comedian: Laughter fills the carriage as a blood-red balloon bursts.
announcement.goal.btt.psychopath: Ma Jiajue decided to act. He took out a stonemason's hammer.
announcement.goal.btt.succubus: Coffee is usually bitter, but today there is a trace of sweetness.
announcement.goal.btt.lawyer: Then who among us dares to ask: is this true?
announcement.goal.btt.godfather: But when you insulted my daughter, you insulted me. When you insult me, you insult my family.
announcement.goal.btt.black_death: Weave a ring of roses. Pockets full of flowers. Ashes. Ashes. We fall down.
announcement.goal.btt.amnesiac: We need only understand the mirror stage as an identification.
announcement.goal.btt.hermit: Existence is everything; everything is for existence.
announcement.goal.btt.traitor: An impulsive killing has left you without allies.
announcement.goal.btt.ex_traitor: Conceal your evil deeds with good ones.
announcement.goal.btt.gambler: The future is in our hands!
announcement.goal.btt.goon: Stand beside the one who reaches out to you.
announcement.goal.btt.novelist: The spectator is the observer. Truth without an observer is no different from fantasy.
announcement.goal.btt.executioner: Terror without virtue is evil; virtue without terror is weak.
announcement.goal.btt.arsonist: The smell of gasoline fills every inch of the air.
announcement.goal.btt.thief: The body was forgotten behind them. Just as I wanted.
announcement.goal.btt.angel: Without a doubt, you are my angel.
announcement.goal.btt.legion: My name is Legion, for we are many.
announcement.goal.btt.majo: Kill them all! Finish them off!
announcement.goal.btt.messiah: Fools say, do not kill! Yet everyone knows the world is full of slaughter.
announcement.goal.btt.kidnapper: What is hidden in the suitcase?
announcement.goal.btt.astral: Astral plane is created by the collective consciousness of the world mind - every thought, memory, fantasy and dream.
announcement.goal.btt.gardener: Flowers fill the train, and death blooms with them.
announcement.goal.btt.voodoo: See through their eyes, speak through their voice. Borrow the voices of all spirits.

btt.newbie.1: Right-click while holding the letter to open the Grimoire.
btt.newbie.10: For passengers, killing with a gun, bow or knife counts as an execution.
btt.newbie.11: Dropping to medium sanity makes you drunk.
btt.newbie.12: Executing a passenger is a wrongful kill; every murderer gains 100 madness.
btt.newbie.13: While drunk, all abilities fail and any information you get is wrong.
btt.newbie.14: Black Death: once you know it exists, passengers should jump off after the outsiders are gone.
btt.newbie.15: Heretic: once you know it exists, murderers should jump off after the outsiders are gone.
btt.newbie.16: Marionette: you believe you are a passenger, but you belong to the murderers and are drunk.
btt.newbie.17: Lunatic: you think you are the principal murderer, but you are on the passenger side; spending madness drains the principal's.
btt.newbie.18: After you die, hold the instinct key to see everyone in their role colour.
btt.newbie.19: Sanity is the passengers' resource; madness is the murderers' resource.
btt.newbie.2: Press K, or click the top-left of your backpack in-game, to open the guide.
btt.newbie.20: You start with a random trait; some traits change abilities and rules.
btt.newbie.3: The instinct key can be set to toggle mode in Controls.
btt.newbie.4: Roles that share a colour never appear together.
btt.newbie.5: Each round has a 50% chance of an encounter.
btt.newbie.6: After fulfilling six needs, passengers can complete a recovery task to receive a random item.
btt.newbie.7: The control console shows the countdown and the living count, and broadcasts to the whole train.
btt.newbie.8: Sitting on the lookout chair outlines every player in green.
btt.newbie.9: Click a portrait in the Grimoire to mark someone dead or missing.
btt.wreath.iris.desc: Win as a solo, outsider, or through a relationship trait
btt.wreath.lily.desc: Perform two correct executions as a passenger
btt.voodoo.remnant: You have joined the Remnant faction as a remnant. Leave the train to pass on permanently.
btt.ending.quote.angel: Your eyes, so beautiful they overturn the very meaning of happiness, took everything from me without mercy.
btt.ending.quote.archenemy: I called for a spring storm and wept — my heart was already wounded
btt.ending.quote.arsonist: Cycling through dead variables, heat born of counting.
btt.ending.quote.astral: Let's board the UFO and head to outer space — let's go together
btt.ending.quote.blood: The sins aboard will be buried forever beneath the blizzard.
btt.ending.quote.cold_wave: I breathed the freezing air straight in; my right hand, my lungs, even my heart froze.
btt.ending.quote.executioner: Those wet eyes dyed in the wrong shade — wanting to be reflected on polished scissors
btt.ending.quote.gardener: Please do not forget, even this pain. Please do not forget that we are here.
btt.ending.quote.jester: Yes, I have gone mad — burning feelings like a kaleidoscope
btt.ending.quote.journey: Rolling over wailing ghosts and unfinished grudges, the cold wheels stop turning.
btt.ending.quote.kidnapper: This is the end of summer. The sky pours down blood rain, dissolving along with stomach acid.
btt.ending.quote.legion: Cast the dice; be born according to the number they show. Twisted words and bodies, just like yours.
btt.ending.quote.lovers: If I were to speak of love — what kind of sight is reflected in those eyes?
btt.ending.quote.majo: No matter how many times, no matter how many times, so that I may exist as myself.
btt.ending.quote.messiah: Just like what you gave me without knowing, if I could become someone's heart too.
btt.ending.quote.naku: This time, the body never returned to the ground. After that, there was no one left.
btt.ending.quote.thief: Filling the lungs with cold air, filling the organs with calm life.
btt.ending.quote.trial: Every judgment that must be passed is complete, before the train reaches the terminal.
btt.ending.quote.voodoo: Before it all rots and falls away, farewell to summer and the memories I shared with you.
btt.epilogue.legion.line: Every lingering regret I cannot escape forms another part of this twisted self.
btt.epilogue.legion.title: Legion Epilogue
btt.epilogue.majo.line: Even if I say it is my life, even if I say it is whose life, may it be judged fairly.
btt.epilogue.majo.title: Coven Epilogue
btt.epilogue.messiah.line: Lamenting “such a world” - can it become a reason for someone to live?
btt.epilogue.messiah.title: Cult Epilogue
btt.epilogue.kidnapper.line: The body kept expanding. Probably too greedily, the ruptured stomach spilled into the air.
btt.epilogue.kidnapper.title: Kidnapper Epilogue
btt.epilogue.astral.line: Falling into a love like an alien cattle-mutilation case — investigating the dawn of the fourteenth day
btt.epilogue.astral.title: Astral Epilogue
btt.epilogue.gardener.line: Venom keeps eating away at my body, dazed and drenched by a passing night shower.
btt.epilogue.gardener.title: Gardener's Epilogue
btt.epilogue.cold_wave.line: As the cold spreads, even individual cells reach their end, like stars falling from the sky.
btt.epilogue.cold_wave.title: Cold Wave Epilogue
btt.epilogue.voodoo.line: Let death part us at the end, beneath sunlight almost too much to bear.
btt.epilogue.voodoo.title: Remnant Epilogue
btt.epilogue.survival.line: The last thing I saw was a dream like that: I was floating in the air.
btt.epilogue.survival.title: Survival Epilogue
btt.special.heretic.killer_win: I am a counterfeit trapped by falsehood — a secret fake known only to the fake flower
btt.special.heretic.passenger_win: No flower in this world blooms brighter than a fake one — for it is made of lies
btt.special.blackdeath.blackdeath_win: Humans whose days are numbered — I will show you; come and amuse me
btt.special.blackdeath.passenger_win: Living on, filthily living — if you can create something, then your feelings will live a thousand years

btt.guide.items.title: Items
btt.guide.items.乘客基础道具.body:
[Gun] Cooldown: 10 seconds after a miss, one minute after a hit.
[Bow] Must be drawn. No cooldown after a miss; one minute after a hit. A wrongful kill causes suicide.
[Master Key] Opens any door. Held by one random Enforcer and certain neutrals.
[Door Bolt] Jams a door for one minute. Cooldown: two minutes.
[Remote] Activates the nearest mechanism within 20 blocks. Cooldown: one minute.
btt.guide.items.乘客基础道具.title: Passenger Items
btt.guide.items.免费道具.body:
[Food and Drinks] Fulfill needs.
[Note] Write on it and place it on a wall, floor or ceiling.
[Firecracker] Produces gunshot sounds and is invisible to everyone except the player who placed it.
[Fake Gun] Looks like a real gun and can produce gunshot sounds.
[Room Key] Opens the door to a room.
[Letter] Right-click to open the Grimoire, which lists every player's portrait, number and name. You can annotate their faction, role and status, such as dead or missing. It also shows the number of players in each role category for the round. While holding the letter, players in view glow according to your annotations.
btt.guide.items.免费道具.title: Free Items
btt.guide.items.凶手基础道具.body:
[Knife] Requires charging. Murderer cooldown: one minute.
[Walkie-Talkie] Initially held by all murderers and Undercover. You must hold it to transmit, but not to listen.
[Crowbar] Breaks doors. Held by the Principal Murderer and certain outsiders.
The basic murderer shop sells: Grenade 250, Psychosis Mask 350, Derringer 400, Poison 25, Scorpion 25, Remote 100, Door Bolt 25, Master Key 50, Body Bag 50 and Circuit Breaker 400.
[Poison] Poisons a plate. A poisoned player hears a heartbeat warning and dies after one minute.
[Scorpion] Poisons a bed. Adjacent beds forming a double bed need only one application. A poisoned bed poisons anyone who sleeps in it, every time.
[Psychosis Mask] Enters psychosis mode for 30 seconds: your appearance changes, you gain one shield, and you use a bat with a charged attack to kill.
[Derringer] Holds one bullet. If you miss, killing someone by any means replenishes it.
[Body Bag] Removes a body.
[Circuit Breaker] Cuts power throughout the train, from anywhere.
Exclusive items are selected randomly each round from: Gun 400, Crossbow 400 and Poison Gas Bomb 200.
[Crossbow] Pierces targets and fires multiple projectiles. No cooldown after a miss; consumed after a hit.
[Poison Gas Bomb] Releases poisonous gas that fills a room.
btt.guide.items.凶手基础道具.title: Murderer Items
btt.guide.killers.title: Murderers
btt.guide.killers.主犯凶手.body:
1【Assassin】Starts with a [Knife]. <Identify> another player's role. A correct guess kills them; an incorrect guess exposes your own role. Cooldown: one minute.
2【Agent】Starts with a [Knife]. Looking at a player reveals their role. Heretic appears as a random Investigative or Support Passenger.
3【Actor】Starts with a [Knife]. Can <Play Dead>. Select a living player and either a living or dead player to <Disguise> the first as the second. No cooldown.
4【Stowaway】Starts with a [Knife]. <Hide> to become invisible for 30 seconds. Cooldown: two minutes.
5【Imp】Starts with a [Knife]. <Imprint> a nearby player. If they are a neutral, they become Imp when you die. Changing the target has a one-minute cooldown.
6【Leech】Starts with a [Knife]. Once per game, <Parasitize> a nearby player. You can die only if they die.
7【Riot】While you live, anyone executed enters a five-second dying state and receives a gun that cannot be dropped.
8【Leviathan】While you live, the murderers win as soon as three wrongful kills have occurred.
9【Sculptor】<Rebuild> any passenger or murderer into a passenger or murderer role not currently in play, without changing their faction. Cooldown: two minutes.
10【Vortex】While you live, all Investigative Passengers are drunk. If two consecutive minutes pass without an execution, the murderers win.
11【Magician】Starts with a [Knife]. <Swap> any two players' positions. Cooldown: one minute.
12【Rigger】Starts with a [Knife]. <Bind> any two players for 30 seconds. Cooldown: one minute.
btt.guide.killers.主犯凶手.title: Principal Murderers
btt.guide.killers.从犯凶手.body:
1【Swordsman】Starts with a [Sword]. Throw a flying sword that pierces a line of players. Cooldown: two minutes.
2【Hikikomori】Starts with an [Iron Pipe]. Draw it to kill without charging for five seconds, followed by a two-minute cooldown.
3【Alchemist】Starts with a [Poison Needle]. Inject poison into a nearby player, plate or bed. Cooldown: 30 seconds.
4【Cleaner】Starts with a [Dagger]. Silent, no charge time, one-minute cooldown. <Cleanse> dropped items. Cooldown: two minutes.
5【Terrorist】Starts with a [Bomb]. Cooldown: 30 seconds. It becomes visible five seconds after activation, can be passed on after holding it for three seconds, and explodes after a 15-second countdown. Either pass it to someone else or be caught in the blast yourself.
6【Warden】Starts with a [Cage]. Select three players with it; after a short delay, they enter the cage and become deaf and mute. They have 15 seconds to choose life or death. If all choose life, all die.
7【Colonel】Starts with a [Gun]. Can toggle <Feign Virtue> at any time. While active, using a gun counts as a passenger execution, and you can drop and pick up guns.
8【Lawyer】Starts with a [Gun]. <Cover> a nearby player, granting immunity to one execution. Cooldown: two minutes.
9【Comedian】Starts with a [Balloon]. Use it on a nearby player to change their voice after a delay. Cooldown: 30 seconds. The first change raises their pitch; the second makes them explode. <Isolate> a nearby player after a delay, making them deaf and mute for 30 seconds. Cooldown: 30 seconds.
10【Psychopath】Starts with a [Fire Axe]. Drawing it grants one shield until you kill someone, after which the axe enters a one-minute cooldown.
11【Succubus】Starts with a [Knife]. <Bewitch> any player, making them drunk for one minute.
12【Godfather】Starts with a [Knife]. <Revenge> any player. Whenever a neutral dies, your chosen target dies.
btt.guide.killers.从犯凶手.title: Accomplice Murderers
btt.guide.neutrals.title: Neutrals
btt.guide.neutrals.外人中立.body:
1【Majo】Belongs to the Coven faction. Starts with a [Gun] with a one-minute cooldown. Firing it is not an execution, so you do not drop it. Starts with one shield; whoever breaks it becomes a follower and joins your faction. Members can see each other through instinct. Can trigger the Majo epilogue.
2【Messiah】Belongs to the Cult faction. <Preach> to any player by guessing their role. Cooldown: one minute. A correct guess turns them into a follower and recruits them to the Cult; an incorrect guess exposes your role. Cult members follow neutral rules for picking up guns and performing executions, and can see each other through instinct. When Messiah dies, followers die by martyrdom.
3【Voodoo】Belongs to the Remnant faction. While you live, Enforcers and murderers become remnants in your faction after death. A remnant who jumps off the train becomes a normal spectator. Remnants share the Remnant voice channel and cannot hear other living players. Voodoo can see remnants through instinct and <Resurrect> one temporarily as their former role. After 30 seconds, they disappear and die permanently as a member of the Remnant faction.
4【Legion】Belongs to the Legion faction. Starts with a [Poison Needle]. Players poisoned by you do not die; instead, they join your faction. When the Legion member holding the needle dies, a random member becomes Legion and receives the needle.
5【Kidnapper】Belongs to the Kidnapper faction. <Kidnap> a nearby player. Cooldown: one minute. The victim possesses the Kidnapper until their sanity reaches zero. When the Kidnapper dies, all living captives are released.
6【Astral】Belongs to the Astral faction. <Dream> to leave your body motionless while your spirit observes the world. No cooldown. You continuously know the roles of two living passengers and one living murderer. If your spirit is beside one of them, waking up can kill that player.
7【Gardener】Belongs to the Gardener faction. <Plant> flowers on the train. Cooldown: 30 seconds; flowers must be at least 20 blocks apart. Flowers have three stages: seed for 30 seconds, invisible to others; seedling for one minute, during which they can be uprooted; and mature flower, able to move and attack players, but killed by one hit.
8【Cold Wave】Belongs to the Cold Wave faction. While you live, non-passengers also lose sanity. <Contaminate> a nearby player after a delay. Cooldown: one minute. The target becomes a cold source for one minute and glows for everyone. Anyone within 20 blocks loses sanity three times as fast. If the target dies during this time, their body becomes a permanent cold source. Plates you touch also become cold sources for one minute.
btt.guide.neutrals.外人中立.title: Outsider Neutrals
btt.guide.neutrals.狂人中立.body:
1【Black Death】Belongs to the murderer faction. Starts in patient form. When killed by any means, becomes a pathogen possessing the killer, who becomes the new patient. If that patient is killed, their killer becomes infected. The pathogen uses the murderer Walkie-Talkie channel. Black Death ends only if the patient jumps off the train or dies from mental breakdown; the other murderers then die in burial sacrifice. If Black Death persists until only three players remain, the murderers win.
2【Heretic】Belongs to the passenger faction. Swaps the passenger and murderer victory results, even after your death.
3【Amnesiac】Belongs to the passenger faction. Once per game, <Inherit> a body to become its owner's role, including items, and faction.
4【Gambler】<Wager> on absent roles until you have correctly identified a number equal to one third of all absent roles, rounded down. An incorrect guess has a one-minute cooldown. You then become the last role you guessed correctly.
5【Goon】Belongs to the passenger faction. Anyone about to use an ability on you becomes drunk for one minute, and you join their faction. Cooldown: one minute. During this cooldown, anyone about to use an ability on you becomes drunk for only one second.
6【Hermit】Belongs to the passenger faction. If you survive to the end, you win; otherwise, you lose.
7【Marionette】Belongs to the murderer faction. You believe you are a passenger role not otherwise in play, but you are actually drunk.
8【Lunatic】Belongs to the passenger faction. You believe you are a Principal Murderer role not otherwise in play. Your instinct shows the real Principal Murderer as green, while murderers see you in your role color. You are not drunk, but spending madness also deducts the same amount from the Principal Murderer's madness, even below zero.
9【Traitor】Belongs to the murderer faction. Functions as an ordinary murderer, including starting with a [Knife], except you have no Walkie-Talkie and appear green to murderer instinct.
10【Ex Traitor】Functions as a random Investigative or Support Passenger role not currently in play, except you belong to the murderer faction.
btt.guide.neutrals.狂人中立.title: Mad Neutrals
btt.guide.neutrals.独行中立.body:
1【Novelist】<Deduce> the role of any living or dead player. A correct guess is announced to everyone; an incorrect guess kills you. Win by correctly guessing the roles of one third of the players.
2【Angel】Starts with three shields. Once per game, <Guard> a nearby player, redirecting all subsequent damage they take to you. Win by dying while guarding them.
3【Jester】When executed, enters psychosis mode with shields equal to the number of previous wrongful kills plus one. Win by killing the shooter before psychosis ends. Otherwise, die by curtain call.
4【Executioner】<Vendetta> a nearby player. After a short delay, they learn that they have been framed. Have them executed, then choose another target. Win after two targets have been executed.
5【Arsonist】Starts with a [Master Key]. Instinct reveals all doused players. <Douse> a nearby player with gasoline. Cooldown: 10 seconds; the notification is delayed. Win when all living passengers have been doused.
6【Thief】Starts with a [Master Key]. Instinct reveals bodies. <Scavenge> a body, removing it and briefly revealing all players through walls for 10 seconds. Cooldown: 10 seconds. Win after scavenging bodies equal to one third of the player count.
btt.guide.neutrals.独行中立.title: Solo Neutrals
btt.guide.passengers.title: Passengers
btt.guide.passengers.信息乘客.body:
1【Detective】<Examine> a nearby player to learn whether they have killed anyone. Cooldown: one minute.
2【Prophet】Use <Prophesy> on any three players to learn whether they include the Principal Murderer.
3【Doctor】Can see a body's role, cause of death and time of death.
4【Mortician】Instinct reveals bodies. You can tell whether a body belonged to a passenger.
5【Seamstress】<Tailor> two other players to learn whether exactly one belongs to the passenger faction. Cooldown: one minute.
6【Investigator】<Investigate> a nearby player to learn one passenger role and one murderer role. The target is one of these; if they are a lone neutral or outsider, they are neither. Cooldown: one minute.
7【Journalist】<Track> any player to see them through walls until you change targets. Cooldown: one minute.
8【Engineer】Place an invisible <Camera> that continuously reports players passing by. Retrieve it before placing it elsewhere.
9【Muyuubyou】<Dream> to leave your body motionless while your spirit observes the world. No cooldown.
10【Maid】Players in view who have more than three needs glow for you.
11【Folklorist】Whenever a player in view uses a remote ability, they glow for you.
12【Medium】<Retain> to a player. After death, they continue to possess you. You can choose another only after the previous target becomes a spirit. When you die, the possessing spirit returns to life through your body and becomes permanently drunk.
13【Noble】Has four “family members,” identifiable by looking at them. Exactly one is a murderer.
14【Balloonist】Has four “faction representatives,” identifiable by looking at them. In order, their factions are passenger, lone neutral, murderer and outsider.
btt.guide.passengers.信息乘客.title: Investigative Passengers
btt.guide.passengers.执法乘客.body:
1【Vigilante】Starts with a [Gun]. Does not drop it after an execution. Unlimited sanity.
2【Railway Police】Starts with a [Gun]. Does not drop it after an execution. Unlimited stamina.
3【Hunter】Starts with a [Gun]. Once per game, <Snipe> any player by identifying them as the Principal Murderer. If correct, they die.
4【Judge】Starts with a [Gun]. <Prosecute> by correctly selecting every murderer in play, counting only roles in the murderer category. If correct, all selected murderers die. Cooldown: one minute.
5【Gunslinger】Starts with a [Gun]. Your executions always kill their targets.
6【Night Watchman】Starts with a [Gun]. Permanent night vision. You can see any player who enters psychosis mode through walls.
7【Elder】When death is triggered, enters a five-second dying state and receives a gun, then dies and drops the gun.
8【Saint】When killed, leaves a body, revives in their room, receives a gun and becomes invisible to murderer instinct.
9【Caballero】Starts with a [Bow].
10【Ranger】Starts with a [Bow]. When using it, you die by suicide if the kill is not wrongful, and survive if it is wrongful.
11【Witch】Starts with a [Knife] usable only once. <Curse> any player so that they die with you when you are killed. Changing the target has a one-minute cooldown.
12【Veteran】Starts with a [Knife] usable only three times.
btt.guide.passengers.执法乘客.title: Enforcer Passengers
btt.guide.passengers.行动乘客.body:
1【Undercover】An ordinary passenger, except you have a [Walkie-Talkie] and appear red to murderer instinct.
2【Ex Undercover】Functions as a random Accomplice Murderer role not currently in play, except you belong to the passenger faction.
3【Architect】<Open Passage> at your current location. After 30 seconds, you can teleport back there at any time. Cooldown: one minute.
4【Locksmith】<Repair> a jammed or forced-open door, or jam a door for one minute. Cooldown: 30 seconds. You sense whenever a door is jammed or forced open.
5【Postman】Other players can right-click you with an item in hand to give it to you. Right-click another player while holding an item to give it to them.
6【Craftsman】<Replicate> an item held by another player. After 30 seconds, you can give it to someone else. Cooldown: one minute.
7【Puppeteer】Select two players. If the first uses a targeted ability, all its targets are redirected to the second.
8【Collector】Instinct reveals dropped items and placed notes. <Summon> the nearest dropped item, making it fly into your hand. Cooldown: 30 seconds.
9【Cannibal】<Devour> a body. If its owner was an Investigative or Support Passenger, temporarily become their role for one minute. Cooldown: one minute.
10【Philosopher】Once per game, <Speculate> any passenger role in the script and become that role. If it is already in play, its existing holder becomes drunk until you die.
btt.guide.passengers.行动乘客.title: Active Passengers
btt.guide.passengers.辅助乘客.body:
1【Conductor】Can see the arrival countdown. If you survive until only three players remain, the passengers win immediately.
2【Attendant】Can see the arrival countdown. While you live, it runs twice as fast.
3【Pharmacist】Recognizes poisoned plates and beds. Poisoned players in view glow for you. <Medicate> a player to cure their poison, or fully restore their sanity if healthy. Cooldown: one minute.
4【Bartender】Choose a role to <Pour>. If present, all players of that role become drunk for two minutes. Cooldown: two minutes.
5【Shoujo】Immune to instinct vision. Can <Play Dead>.
6【Poppy Grower】While you live, murderer instinct shows everyone as green.
7【Virgin】Immune to execution. <Honor> a nearby player, making them always die by suicide if they commit a wrongful kill. Cooldown: one minute.
8【Star】On death, glows for the passenger faction for 30 seconds, but not for other factions. <Mark> any player so that they glow with you when you die. Changing the target has a 30-second cooldown.
9【Professor】Use <Vial> to infuse a plate with a potion. Whoever consumes it gains one shield. Cooldown: two minutes.
10【Bodyguard】<Escort> a nearby player for 30 seconds: they can die only if you die. Cooldown: two minutes.
11【Snake Charmer】<Charm> any player. If they are the Principal Murderer, swap roles and factions with them. The new Snake Charmer becomes permanently drunk. Cooldown: one minute.
12【Monk】<Convert> a nearby player. If they are a Solo Neutral, they die immediately upon fulfilling their victory condition and share victory at the ending. Cooldown: one minute. In duel mode, instead, they gain one shield.
btt.guide.passengers.辅助乘客.title: Support Passengers
btt.guide.preface.body:
Press K, or click the button at the top left of your inventory during a round, to read this guide. Survive aboard an express train bound for the terminal station and uncover the truth before it arrives.
The passenger faction must kill all murderers and outsiders, or survive until the train reaches the terminal. The murderer faction must eliminate every other faction except lone neutrals. Each outsider belongs to a separate outsider faction with the same objective: eliminate every other faction except lone neutrals. Lone neutrals have their own victory conditions, independent of whether anyone else survives. Their survival or death does not affect other factions' victory conditions.
Players know their own role, traits and the current encounter. At the start of a round, each player wakes in their room with a room key and a letter. Looking at another player reveals their name. Communication is limited to proximity voice chat.
btt.guide.preface.title: Introduction
btt.guide.rules.title: Rules
btt.guide.rules.场景.body:
The train consists of:
1. Locomotive
2. Baggage car
3. Second-class sleeper: four two-person rooms
4. Dining car
5. Second-class sleeper
6. Bar car
7. First-class sleeper: two two-person rooms
8. Dining car
9. First-class sleeper
10. Bar car
11. Crew sleeper: two two-person rooms
12. Baggage car
13. Guard's van
Baggage cars are open to the air and can fulfill the fresh-air need. Rooms contain beds and plates holding [Notes]. First-class rooms also have plates with [Firecrackers] and [Fake Guns]. More players can occupy a room than its nominal capacity. Glass doors need no key. Wooden doors require a Room Key, Master Key or Crowbar. Steel doors can only be opened with a Master Key or Crowbar.
Locomotive control panel: Open its interface to see the current countdown and number of living players. Anything you say while using it is broadcast throughout the train.
Guard's van lookout seat: While seated, you see everyone on the train glowing green through walls. Immunity to instinct vision still applies.
Chandelier mechanism: Activates for five seconds and makes noise. If a player passes underneath, it becomes a falling block that kills any player it hits. It resets after landing.
Wire mechanism: Activates for five seconds and makes noise. It electrocutes players within a nearby area, accompanied by visual effects.
btt.guide.rules.场景.title: Setting
btt.guide.rules.奇遇.body:
【Dream】When three players remain, they use notes to decide whether to restart the round. If they agree, it immediately restarts with the same roles, but a two-minute countdown.
【Storm】Everyone is told a passenger role that might be present. That role can die only by execution. If it is present, murderers also receive a note identifying the player.
【Fulfilment】The game continues after a Solo Neutral fulfills their victory condition. They appear as a winner in the ending. Counteracting role: Monk.
【Hypocrisy】Non-passengers can pick up guns and bows. Using one counts as an execution and makes them drop it. Non-passengers never trigger wrongful-kill checks, whether performing executions or other killings.
【Rebirth】The first two passengers to die are resurrected as Solo Neutral roles not currently in play.
【Affinity】Duplicate roles may appear.
【Supreme Good】Everyone receives a note listing the round's role lineup. Counteracting roles: Heretic, Black Death.
【Judgment】Anyone who commits a wrongful kill dies by suicide. Counteracting role: Virgin.
btt.guide.rules.奇遇.title: Encounters
btt.guide.rules.模式.body:
【Script Mode】6–24 players, balanced around 18. Three scripts are available. Scripts only restrict which Principal Murderers and Enforcer Passengers may appear. A script is selected randomly at the start and announced in the action bar. In the following lists, the odd-numbered role in each same-color pair represents both roles:
- Trouble Brewing: Imp, Actor, Vigilante, Witch.
- Bad Moon Rising: Assassin, Magician, Hunter, Gunslinger.
- Sects & Violets: Sculptor, Vortex, Caballero, Elder.
【Draft Mode】Based on Script Mode, but without script restrictions: any role may appear. In random order, each player picks from three roles or chooses Random. A specific pick is public, so everyone knows that role is present. A Random pick remains hidden.
【Duel Mode】Based on Script Mode, with only passenger and murderer factions. Solo Neutrals join the passengers, and Outsider Neutrals join the murderers. When a Solo Neutral fulfills their victory condition, they become permanently drunk and get a gun.
【Debate Mode】6–18 players, balanced around 12. Enforcers' guns and bows become single-use, and knives lose two uses. Murderers cannot buy weapon items. Reporting a body starts a one-minute meeting and makes the bodies of everyone who died since the previous meeting glow. Players then have 30 seconds to vote using notes. The player with the most votes is executed if they receive at least half the votes. If multiple players tie for the lead with at least half the votes, they become drunk until the next meeting instead.
【Reminiscence Mode】Based on Debate Mode. Opening text and ability text contain no role-identifying information. Each player can use a note to guess their own role, receiving an answer ranging from “Unrelated” through “Close” to “Perfect.” Cooldown: 30 seconds.
btt.guide.rules.模式.title: Modes
btt.guide.rules.流程.body:
Executions. When a passenger kills someone with a gun, bow or knife, it counts as an execution. Executing a passenger is a wrongful kill. A wrongful kill causes the executor to die by suicide only when performed with a bow. Every wrongful kill grants all murderers 100 madness. Performing an execution costs 40 sanity and makes the executor drop their gun. A player immune to execution survives with a shield-breaking sound, but the wrongful-kill check still applies.
Death. Death leaves a body. Some roles can remove bodies. Causes of death include accident, mental breakdown, gunshot, arrow, suicide, stabbing, magic, mishap, blunt weapon, axe, poison, bomb, grenade, flying sword, dagger, helium, curtain call, bloom, martyrdom, burial sacrifice and dying for love.
Epilogues. When the combined number of murderers and outsiders is at least the number of passengers, the countdown is reduced to two minutes. An epilogue begins whenever the countdown falls below two minutes, with background music playing during it. Passengers can trigger the survival epilogue, while outsiders can trigger their own epilogues. Priority is Coven / Cult > Remnant / Legion > Kidnapper / Astral > Gardener / Cold Wave > Passengers. If the featured faction is eliminated and another outsider faction remains, the epilogue switches to that faction's epilogue; otherwise, it becomes the survival epilogue. The featured faction wins when its epilogue ends.
Endings. Passenger victory has two different quotes: passengers win either by killing all murderers and Outsider Neutrals before arrival, or by reaching the terminal before killing them all. Murderer victory also has two quotes: murderers win by killing all passengers and Outsider Neutrals while the Principal Murderer is still alive, or Accomplice Murderers finish the task after the Principal has died. Black Death and Heretic have special passenger and murderer victory endings with their own quotes. If multiple victory conditions are met at once, priority is Conductor > Black Death > Relationship Traits > Solo Neutrals > Outsiders > Murderers > Passengers. After the ending, the replay plays automatically and wreaths are awarded as dyed leather helmets.
btt.guide.rules.流程.title: Round Flow
btt.guide.rules.能力.body:
Sanity. Sanity is the passenger resource. It starts at 100 and decreases naturally. Below 55, players see incorrect items and become drunk; below 20, they also see incorrect skins. Reaching zero causes immediate death. Fulfilling a periodically generated need restores 20 sanity. Each new need is selected randomly from eating, drinking, sleeping, fresh air, company, solitude, bathing and music. Up to four needs can accumulate. After completing the sixth need, a player receives a task: return to their room, operate the control panel, or inspect the lookout seat. Completing it awards a random Door Bolt, Remote or Walkie-Talkie. This Walkie-Talkie uses the passenger channel; Undercover does not receive another Walkie-Talkie.
Madness. Madness is the murderer resource, used to buy items from the portable murderer shop. Only murderers have madness. They gain 5 every 10 seconds, stopping natural regeneration when madness exceeds 200. A kill grants 100 madness.
Abilities. Names in angle brackets, such as <Ability>, denote active abilities. Nearby abilities are used with the ability key and either affect someone beside you or require no target. Remote abilities target any player through the inventory menu. Unless stated otherwise, all abilities have an initial cooldown; abilities without a regular cooldown have a 30-second initial cooldown. Talents are passive abilities. The murderer shop also counts as an ability. Drunkenness is hidden from the affected player. While drunk, abilities, talents and shops fail: non-information abilities have no effect, and information abilities provide false information. Drunk murderers are refused when trying to spend madness.
btt.guide.rules.能力.title: Abilities
btt.guide.rules.角色.body:
Categories. There are three main role categories. Passengers have four subcategories: Enforcer, Active, Investigative and Support. Murderers have two: Principal and Accomplice. Neutrals have three: Solo, Outsider and Mad. Mad Neutrals occupy neutral seats, but this category does not itself designate the lone-neutral faction or a specific outsider faction.
Seats. For N players, the number of murderers is N // 6, Solo Neutrals 1 + N // 12, Outsider Neutrals N // 12, and Mad Neutrals N // 8, where // means integer division. There is exactly one Principal Murderer. Passenger seats are divided equally among the four subcategories, with remaining seats assigned in this order: Enforcer > Active > Investigative > Support. Roles cannot repeat, and roles sharing a color cannot appear together. A standard 18-player round has 3 Enforcers, 3 Active Passengers, 2 Investigative Passengers, 2 Support Passengers, 1 Principal Murderer, 2 Accomplice Murderers, 2 Solo Neutrals, 1 Outsider Neutral and 2 Mad Neutrals.
Factions. Roles and factions may change during a round. Generally, passengers and lone neutrals have limited stamina: when it runs too low, they cannot sprint and must stand still to recover. Murderers and outsiders have unlimited stamina. Only murderers and outsiders can see the arrival countdown. It starts at eight minutes and gains one minute whenever a passenger dies. Murderer instinct reveals all players through walls: murderers glow red, and everyone else glows green. Only passengers drop their guns and master keys on death, and only passengers can pick them up. In particular, if an Enforcer joins any other faction after having dropped their gun or bow, they receive it again; it is removed when they return to the passenger faction. Some players are told a different role from their actual technical role; this is a perception override. Some roles use another role's abilities, while others temporarily become a different role. The role initially assigned to a player is their initial role.
btt.guide.rules.角色.title: Roles
btt.guide.title: Before the Terminal Guide
btt.guide.traits.title: Traits
btt.guide.traits.乘客特质.body:
【Talkative】Sanity does not decrease while you speak.
【Hoarding】You can take two portions of food or drink.
【Justice】You always die by suicide after a wrongful kill.
【Chaste】Anyone who wrongfully kills you always dies by suicide.
【Gluttonous】You finish food and drinks instantly.
【Hollow】Reaching zero sanity does not kill you.
【Cleanly】You can recognize poisoned plates and beds.
【Anxious】Needs are generated 1.5 times as fast.
【Endurance】Unlimited stamina.
【Optimist】Unlimited sanity.
btt.guide.traits.乘客特质.title: Passenger Traits
btt.guide.traits.关系特质.body:
【Lover】Randomly assigned. You know your partner's name. When one dies, the other dies for love. If both survive until the game ends, both win with the “Lovers Survived” announcement.
【Archenemy】Pairs one Investigative or Support Passenger with one Accomplice Murderer. Both know each other's name and role. If the passenger is executed, the murderer wins alone with the “Archenemy's Revenge” announcement.
【Twins】Randomly assigned. You know your twin's name and role. Twins always share a faction. At initial faction assignment and whenever either changes faction, this priority determines whether they keep their faction or both change: Outsider > Murderer > Passenger > Lone Neutral.
【Nemesis】Pairs one passenger with one non-passenger. Both know each other's name. If the non-passenger dies first, the passenger becomes Majo. If the passenger dies first, the non-passenger becomes Jester.
btt.guide.traits.关系特质.title: Relationship Traits
btt.guide.traits.凶手特质.body:
【Stealth】Entering psychosis mode does not play music.
【Playful】Killing a player who is speaking grants an extra 100 madness.
【Closure】Players you kill with melee weapons leave no body.
【Reckless】You can pick up guns and bows, but hitting someone with one always makes you die by suicide.
【Premeditated】If you can see other murderers through instinct, they appear in their respective role colors.
【Slacker】Completing a fake task grants 25 madness.
【Greedy】When a teammate dies, you inherit their madness.
【Anatomy】You can examine bodies.
btt.guide.traits.凶手特质.title: Murderer Traits
btt.guide.traits.外人特质.body:
【Last Wish】Whoever kills you joins your faction.
【Bond】One passenger starts as a member of your faction.
【Insight】You have green instinct vision.
【Profiling】Looking at a Solo Neutral reveals their role.
btt.guide.traits.外人特质.title: Outsider Traits
btt.guide.traits.独行特质.body:
【Afterlife】Start with one shield. When someone breaks it, you join their faction.
【Disguised】Anyone about to use an ability on you becomes drunk for one second.
【Catcher】You can die only by execution.
【Uprising】You have a knife.
btt.guide.traits.独行特质.title: Solo Traits
btt.guide.traits.通用特质.body:
【Tease】On death, broadcasts a fake epilogue title and music belonging to an outsider not in play, for up to two minutes.
【Reserved】Walking, eating, drinking and similar actions make no sound.
【Trust】Five seconds after the round begins, a member of your faction learns that you share their faction. If there is none, someone from another faction receives this false information instead.
【Crush】When you die, one passenger becomes permanently drunk.
【Afterglow】When death is triggered, enter a five-second dying state.
【Lucky】Whenever you take damage, you have a 50% chance to survive.
【Familiar】Item cooldowns are halved.
【Excellent】Ability cooldowns are halved.
【Sleight】Your held item is hidden.
【Energetic】You can jump.
【Childlike】Your body becomes smaller.
【Light】Permanent slow falling.
【Night Owl】Permanent night vision.
【Impatient】Movement speed is multiplied by 1.1.
【Spirit Sense】You are notified whenever someone dies.
【Obstinate】Your death is announced to everyone.
【Resonant】If you survive until the epilogue, everyone glows during it.
【Allergic】You are notified whenever someone uses a remote ability on you.
